text: Employees must rotate production credentials every 90 days. Rotation must be completed through the approved secrets manager.
Tier 3 mutations require an authorized human approver before the workflow transition is committed.
The incident severity classification is SEV-1 for active customer data loss, SEV-2 for significant degradation, and SEV-3 for minor impact.
SKU-099 refers to the North America enterprise support plan. It may be renewed only after account ownership is verified.
LOT-00044 is reserved for the 2026 compliance documentation batch. It is read-only until approval by the compliance reviewer.
For cache isolation, the Redis key is SHA256(tenant_id:user_id:normalized_query) and must include a jittered TTL of 300 seconds plus or minus 45 seconds.
A ReAct loop is bounded to five iterations, 120 milliseconds per step, and 450 milliseconds total.
